answer: Attacker cost rises superlinearly: forging N identities requires N bonds plus reputation history, making marginal sybil profit negative. Each agent must lock a bond in a shared vault before voting; identity weight scales with stake and tenure, so a sybil swarm fragments its collateral across many accounts, and any single ripple of misbehavior slashes every linked vertex in that cluster.
